t: You're standing at the memorial to King George the Sixth and Queen Elizabeth, the Queen Mother, between The Mall and Carlton Gardens. It was completed in its present form in 2009. It includes an earlier statue of the king by William McMillan, unveiled in 1955 by his daughter, Queen Elizabeth the Second. The statue of the Queen Mother is by Philip Jackson. George the Sixth was king from 1936 until his death in 1952, and his wife was queen consort for those same years. Louis de Soissons is also credited with the memorial.
